name: Kongo Bongo
status: Founded as 'Donkey Kong Country'; its banana reserve vanished on the day of its first coinage.
summary: The Kong nation ratified in the account's flashback, whose hundreds of millions of bananas disappeared overnight, and whose founding war deposed the King of the Gnawties and Master Necky.

name: Elysian Plains
status: Where Pit filmed Donkey Kong at the edge of obliteration.
summary: Open ground beyond death where Pit skateboards; his video from here claims to show Donkey Kong surrendering his soul.

name: Mountain Mines
status: Master Necky was found dead in his gilded chambers just before the Kongs marched on it.
summary: The seat of Master Necky. The war remembered in the DK flashback was about to march on it when Necky was found on his floor with his neck broken.
